fullPassage: We often express problems interrogatively. Instead of commanding you to find my lost keys, I ask you, "Do you know where my keys are?" The question, in its surface form, seems to be a simple yes-or-no question about your knowledge, but you understand it as a request for help. Consider a common scenario: some feature of our domestic landscape goes wrong — the toilet keeps running, the drain gets clogged. Since there are possible things we could specify about the problem, we might wonder which description would be best. But as long as we can achieve the goal of getting the problem resolved, it doesn't matter precisely how we express the problem. We don't need to say, "The float and flapper of my toilet are out of alignment." We can simply say, "The toilet won't stop running." The goal is not to express the problem in its most technically correct form but to express it in a way that enables us to resolve the problem. Indeed, the best expression of a problem is one that also offers a tidy resolution.

Consider a common scenario: some feature of our domestic landscape ①<u>goes</u> wrong — the toilet keeps running, the drain gets clogged. Since there are possible things ②<u>we could specifying</u> about the problem, we might wonder which description would be best. But as long as we can achieve the goal of getting the problem resolved, it doesn't matter precisely ③<u>how</u> we express the problem. We don't need to say, "The float and flapper of my toilet are out of alignment." We can simply say, "The toilet won't stop running." The goal is not to express the problem in its most technically correct form but to express it in a way that enables us to resolve the problem. Indeed, the best expression of a problem is ④<u>one</u> that also offers a tidy resolution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ②잘못되다 ①우리가 명시할 수 있는 ④어떻게 ③하나
det.analysis:
② how: 간접의문문 how we express — 어법상 적절
① specifying: could specifying? → 조동사 뒤 원형 필요. 원문은 could specify ←정답
④ goes: some feature goes wrong에서 3인칭 단수 동사 — 어법상 적절
③ one: one that also offers에서 부정대명사 — 어법상 적절
det.tip: 조동사(could) + 동사원형(specify). 조동사 뒤에 V-ing 형태는 불가.

det.korean: 문제를 해결할 수 있게 하는 방식으로
det.analysis: in a way that enables us to resolve the problem: 전치사구 + 관계대명사절 + to부정사 구문

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① 기술적 표현 방법 — 글은 오히려 기술적 표현이 불필요하다고 함
② 가정 수리 — 수리는 예시일 뿐 주제가 아님
③ 문제 해결을 위한 효과적 의사소통 — 핵심 주제: 해결 가능한 방식으로 문제를 표현 ←정답
④ 질문과 명령의 차이 — 도입부 예시일 뿐 전체 주제가 아님
det.tip: 글의 핵심: 기술적 정확성보다 문제 해결을 가능하게 하는 표현이 중요.

det.analysis:
① 전문 용어로 설명 — 글의 논지와 반대
